verdict.rationale: The evidence describes per-flag lifecycle features (gradual rollout, scheduling, segments, RBAC, environments) and a general-purpose Admin API, but nowhere documents a bulk-edit, bulk-toggle, or batch operation capability across many flags/items at once; export/import (unleash-docs-16) is for migration, not bulk editing. Since feature-flag platforms plausibly could offer bulk operations, the axis applies but no evidence shows it is delivered.
